title: Centralize misroute guard into shared function to prevent drift
context: Issue #54 identified a bug where agents forget cwd, silently committing work to the wrong checkout when files exist in linked worktrees. PR #63 added protection to hunch_record_decision, but hunch_record_correction and hunch_record_finding have identical shape, root cause, and blast radius yet remain unprotected. Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Extract the misroute refusal logic into a single misrouteGuard() function called by all three auto-committing write tools. Export repoRelativeHint so hunch_record_correction can relativize absolute scope_hint_file paths before checking, mirroring buildCorrectionConstraint's behavior.
consequences: One source of truth for misroute detection and refusal messaging; future changes propagate uniformly
All three tools now enforce the same guard and use identical language, eliminating inconsistency
Added tests verify the guard works for hunch_record_correction (with absolute and relative paths) and hunch_record_finding, plus negative tests for false positives
alternatives_rejected: Duplicate the guard logic in each tool (risks drift as behavior evolves)
Apply the guard inconsistently to only hunch_record_decision (leaves identical tools unprotected)
